description: Research thumbnails assembled with code-native SVG image placement. All research imagery is copied or cropped from original official sources without retouching, compositing image pixels, generated outputs or synthesized motion.

faithfulfaces.layout: Left: exact square reference image and small Reference label/arrow. Right: two full-width official boxing frames at 0.75s and 4.75s. White scientific comparison layout, no promotional typography.
faithfulfaces.video_encoding: ffmpeg -i SOURCE -t 5.0625 -vf scale=720:432:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=720:432,setsar=1,fps=24 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart OUTPUT
faithfulfaces.motion: Entire original 16fps boxing video sampled to 24fps without interpolation or speed changes. Only small center crop for 5:3 container. Replaces prior static Figure 13 park comparison.
faithfulfaces.poster_alt: Input reference face and two official FaithfulFaces boxing frames showing facial occlusion and a changed head pose.
faithfulfaces.video_aria_label: FaithfulFaces: continuous generated boxing video from a single reference face. Hover or focus to play.

ipa.layout: Matched second displayed column of the right-hand Figure 8 example: VACE xref 893 on the left, IPA/Ours xref 873 on the right. Identical SVG crop (x=0,y=38,w=240,h=260) preserves faces and hand gestures. Labels identify actual method rows.
ipa.video_change: None. Retains existing verified seven-second paper-still comparison with editorial reveal; no official matching original video is published.
ipa.image_note: Original embedded PDF image bytes exclude annotation rectangles drawn separately in PDF. No image pixels were retouched.

personavlog.layout: Four tall panels: photographic reference shown in the official comparison figure, followed by three frames of the same printed-dress character from official video 03, in garden, sketching and woodland scenes. Small Reference / Generated story headings make the input and stylized output explicit.
personavlog.reference_scope: The figure and video use the same printed-dress reference character across different narrative themes; the cover makes no claim that the coastal figure and woodland video have the same theme.
personavlog.video_change: None. Retains existing continuous 12.75–19.5 second official excerpt, 6.75 seconds total.
personavlog.source_limit: All six official project videos are stylized animated results. A photorealistic generated result is not publicly supplied and was not invented for this redesign.

visual_check: Browser rendered all three SVGs at both 360×216 and 200×120. Proof is cover-redesign-20261027/identity/proof.png in task scratch. No cropped captions or method names are included as pixels.
